text:
maria: Quick sync — AltChip says they're ready to run the joint perf/W + throughput baseline next week. We need to lock workloads, telemetry keys, kernel knobs, and the marketplace packaging. @lee_altchip you + kernel team available?

lee_altchip: Yep, we're good. Kernel team wants the exact kernel patch list and a headroom target for perf/W (watts per token) so we can set tuning knobs. Can you share the workload list?

sam_eng: For workloads I'd prioritize: 1) long-context gen (seq 2048, batch 1), 2) chat-like steady throughput (seq 512, batch 8), 3) embeddings (batch 64). Models: redwood-verified Llama2-70B and an OPT-13B variant for throughput parity.

olivia_pm: Heads-up: marketing wants a joint marketplace listing ready to drop with the announcement. Need artifact checklist: validated perf report, official logos, partner blurb, and an embargo window. Can we target internal review by Thu?

bench-bot: test-harness snippet for reproducibility:
```
benchctl run \
  --partner altchip \
  --model llama-70b \
  --seq 2048 \
  --batch 1 \
  --measure "tokens/sec,p50,p95,watts,temp" \
  --quant-profile int4_qv2 \
  --repeat 5
```
Collect tags: model, seq, batch, quant_profile, kernel_patch, firmware_rev, rack_id

ryan_sre: Important: telemetry endpoints must include power readings (IPMI/PMBus) and exporter to prometheus. For Private customers we need IP allowlist for AltChip telemetry host and an audit event when we send telemetry to partners. Also confirm KMS policy for marketplace artifact signing.

lee_altchip: Kernel notes from our side: enable ALTC_KTUNE=3, apply sparse-attn patch v1.2, and avoid mmu_coalesce on heavy IO runs. We'll supply a patchset and a small script to toggle knobs. Also will provide thermals profile file named altchip_therm_v3.json.

sam_eng: Quick perf target suggestions: baseline tokens/sec >= 70% of our current prod 70B on A100 for seq 2048, and perf/W improvement >= 1.2x vs last-gen. For throughput tests measure sustained tokens/sec over 10 minutes.

lee_altchip: Understood. We'll run an initial dry-run this Fri with the patchset and return the CSV of metrics. Any constraints on power rails or cooling?

ryan_sre: Yes — please cap racks to standard datacenter PDU settings (20A per phase), and tag any runs where thermal throttling occurs. If throttling happens, record frequency scaling trace.

olivia_pm: Announcement timeline proposal: dry-run Fri -> internal review Mon -> hold for embargo 10 business days after internal review -> joint blog + marketplace listing + partner tweet on embargo lift. Marketing will draft the partner blurb; need a performance quote from AltChip legal by review. :eyes:

maria: OK owners: Sam = workload & harness, Lee = kernel patchset + thermals, Ryan = telemetry & infra constraints, Olivia = announcement coordination and marketplace artifacts. I'll follow up with a short Confluence checklist. Let's keep chatter here for blockers. :rocket:
